scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,ai -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @podbae/web" "npm run dev -w @podbae/api" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.dev:ai: cd services/ai && conda run -n torch_gpu --no-capture-output python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:ai && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed && npm run intel:migrate
scripts.setup:ai: conda run -n torch_gpu pip install -r services/ai/requirements.txt
scripts.reset: rimraf data && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.test:ai: cd services/ai && conda run -n torch_gpu python -m pytest -q
scripts.intel:migrate: cd services/ai && conda run -n torch_gpu python -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.intel:seed: cd services/ai && conda run -n torch_gpu --no-capture-output python -u scripts/intel_seed.py
scripts.intel:eval: cd services/ai && conda run -n torch_gpu --no-capture-output python -u scripts/eval_layer1.py report
scripts.intel:diagnose-feeds: cd services/ai && conda run -n torch_gpu --no-capture-output python -u scripts/feed_diagnose.py
